dct_title_s: Scripture lands : described in a series of historical, geographical, and topographical sketches
dct_description_sm: By John Kitto. And illustrated by a complete Biblical atlas, comprising twenty-four maps, with an index of reference.
Text -- Maps -- A new general index, exhibiting, at one view, all that is geographically and historically interesting in the Holy Scriptures.
Master and use copy. Digital master created according to Benchmark for Faithful Digital Reproductions of Monographs and Serials, Version 1. Digital Library Federation, December 2002.
Description based on print version record.
Copy held in The Leonard and Juliet Rothman Holy Land Map Collection is not shown; digital imagery provided is from 1866 reprint.
